rightClickMode.playerladder.description: Action that occurs when you click on a player/entity.
shiftClickMode.playerladder.description: Action that occurs when you shift click on a player/entity.
pickUpLimit.playerladder.description: Limits how many entities a player can pick up.
stepUpLimit.playerladder.description: Limits how many entities up a player can go.
throwStrength.playerladder.description: Sets strength of the throw when force dismounting a passenger. Set to zero to disable throwing.
allowForceDismount.playerladder.descript: Allows force dismounting player passengers when shift clicking on the ground or air.
dismountOnGameModeChange.playerladder.de: Whether entities should be dismounted from a player when the player's game mode changes(switching to spectator would dismount the entity even if this option is disabled).
requireCrouchToRide.playerladder.descrip: Requires the (vehicle) player to be sneaking in order for another player to mount them.
allowRidingEntities.playerladder.descrip: Allows riding any entity (Apart from the excluded list).
allowPickingUpEntities.playerladder.desc: Allows picking up any living entity (Apart from the excluded list).
rideEntityBacklist.playerladder.descript: The list of living entities that can't be ridden. Supports entity tags e.g: #minecraft:dismounts_underwater
pickUpEntityBlacklist.playerladder.descr: The list of living entities that can't be picked up. Supports entity tags e.g: #minecraft:dismounts_underwater
invertRideEntityList.playerladder.descri: Treats the list of excluded riding entities as a whitelist instead of a blacklist.
invertPickUpEntityList.playerladder.desc: Treats the list of excluded picking up entities as a whitelist instead of a blacklist.
rideExtension.playerladder.description: Allows the /ride command to mount entities on top of players.
allowInteractions.playerladder.descripti: Allows interacting with the world while there's an entity on top of you.
